info.title: HermesNET
info.description: Hermes.NET: Distributed agent runtime with skills, tools, memory, and observability.

commands.name: chat
commands.description: Send a chat message and receive a model response

options.name: --profile
options.description: Profile name to use for this chat session

options.name: --message
options.description: Message to send to the model

commands.name: profile
commands.description: Manage Hermes profiles

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a new profile

commands.name: list
commands.description: List all profiles

commands.name: switch
commands.description: Set the active profile

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: Profile name or ID to switch to

commands.name: current
commands.description: Show the active profile

commands.name: session
commands.description: Manage Hermes sessions

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a new session under the current profile

options.name: --profile
options.description: Profile ID to create session under (defaults to current profile)

commands.name: list
commands.description: List sessions for the current profile

options.name: --profile
options.description: Profile ID to list sessions for (defaults to current profile)

commands.name: switch
commands.description: Set the active session

commands.name: current
commands.description: Show the active session

commands.name: memory
commands.description: Manage curated profile memory (MEMORY.md / USER.md)

commands.name: show
commands.description: Display MEMORY.md content for a profile

options.name: --profile
options.description: Profile ID to show memory for (defaults to current profile)

commands.name: update
commands.description: Replace MEMORY.md content for a profile

options.name: --profile
options.description: Profile ID to update memory for (defaults to current profile)

commands.name: profile-show
commands.description: Display USER.md content for a profile

options.name: --profile
options.description: Profile ID to show USER.md for (defaults to current profile)

commands.name: skill
commands.description: Manage and inspect loaded skills

commands.name: list
commands.description: List all skills loaded in the registry

commands.name: show
commands.description: Display a skill definition and metadata

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: Skill ID or name to display

commands.name: config
commands.description: Configure the active LLM provider and model settings
